from pathlib import Path
import httpx._models as models
import httpx._decoders as decoders
assert models.TextDecoder is decoders.TextDecoder
assert Path(decoders.__file__).resolve().is_relative_to(Path.cwd())
import httpx
import pytest

@pytest.mark.parametrize('data, expected', [
    ((b"ok \xe2", b"\x82\xac"), "ok \u20ac"),
    ((b"ok \xe2", b"\x82"), "ok \ufffd"),
], ids=['valid-split', 'incomplete-at-eof'])
@pytest.mark.parametrize('mode', ['sync', 'async'])
@pytest.mark.anyio
async def test_utf8_finalization(data, expected, mode):
    if mode == 'sync':
        response = httpx.Response(200, content=iter(data))
        actual = ''.join(response.iter_text())
    else:
        async def chunks():
            for chunk in data:
                yield chunk
        response = httpx.Response(200, content=chunks())
        actual = ''.join([part async for part in response.aiter_text()])
    assert actual == expected
